# MusicMix - optional heavy critics for Linux (CPU only).
#
# Section A installs ON TOP of the core venv (/opt/musicmix/venv):
#   uv pip install --python /opt/musicmix/venv/bin/python -r env/requirements-core.txt \
#       -r env/requirements-critics.txt --index-strategy unsafe-best-match
#
# SongEval/MuQ is NOT installable here: muq 0.1.0 imports transformers.deepspeed
# and was run on Windows with transformers 4.42.3 + numpy 1.26.4 (paths
# prepended by tools/run_pretrained_music_critic.py:31-40). It lives with CUE-DETR
# in env/requirements-legacy-np1.txt (separate venv).

# --- A. Audiobox Aesthetics (.cache/critic_runtime, used by src/musicmix/aesthetic_critic.py)
# Windows ran it with structure_runtime + asr_runtime + global torch 2.14.0+cpu,
# i.e. the same numpy 2.4.6 / huggingface_hub 2.2.0 stack as the core venv.

rich==15.0.0
submitit==1.5.3
safetensors==0.8.0
# weights: .cache/models/audiobox_aesthetics (HF facebook/audiobox-aesthetics @ 9b1dd8e5df9af7216e836a98974fe3b82c56ded6)

# --- B. TenseMusic / basic-pitch (research only, NOT wired into src/ or tools/)
# runs/result_swarm_v12/agents/official_tension/runtime used tensorflow-cpu 2.15.1,
# numpy 1.26.4, scipy 1.11.4, protobuf 4.25.9, keras 2.15.0 -> incompatible with
# both the core venv (numpy 2.x, protobuf 7) and the legacy venv (scipy 1.17).
# If ever needed, build a THIRD venv (Python 3.11) with exactly:
#   basic-pitch==0.4.0 tensorflow-cpu==2.15.1 numpy==1.26.4 scipy==1.11.4
#   librosa==0.10.2.post1 resampy==0.4.3 mir_eval==0.8.2 pretty_midi==0.2.10
